description: This file declares several kernel launch functions related to reduction operations for tensors in the ATen library, presumably for CUDA GPU acceleration.

methods.name: norm_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing the norm of tensor elements.

methods.name: min_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing the minimum value in a tensor.

methods.name: max_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing the maximum value in a tensor.

methods.name: aminmax_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing the minimum and maximum values in a tensor.

methods.name: min_all_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing the minimum across all tensor elements.

methods.name: max_all_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing the maximum across all tensor elements.

methods.name: aminmax_allreduce_launch_kernel
methods.description: Launch kernel for computing both min and max across all tensor elements, possibly using reduction.
